name: rimo
description: Rimo Voice for Claude Desktop — list, read, search, and ask across your meeting notes, transcripts, and documents.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to your Rimo Voice workspace. Once installed, Claude can list your notes, fetch transcripts and attached documents, search by keyword or meaning, and answer natural-language questions across your notes.

Everything needed is included — no separate install. To sign in, paste a personal API key (created in the Rimo web app) into the extension settings. If you also use the `rimo` CLI, you can leave the key blank and the extension reuses your `rimo auth login` session.

tools.name: note_list_attended
tools.description: List notes you participated in as an attendee.

tools.name: note_get
tools.description: Fetch one note by ID (metadata by default; meta=false for full contents).

tools.name: note_list_documents
tools.description: List documents attached to a note.

tools.name: note_get_document
tools.description: Fetch one document by ID from a note.

tools.name: note_ask
tools.description: Natural-language Q&A with an AI-synthesised answer plus sources.

api_key.title: Rimo API key (optional)
api_key.description: Create a key in the Rimo web app (Settings → API Key) and paste it here. Leave blank if you already signed in with `rimo auth login`.
